name: docker-asterisk
description: Docker image providing Asterisk PBX with PrivateDial configuration, WebSMS messaging, and AutoBan intrusion detection. Multi-variant images (mini, base, full, extra).

docker_support.docker_evidence: Multi-stage Dockerfile with Alpine Linux base. Docker Hub image mlan/asterisk with variants (mini, base, full, extra). Demo docker-compose in demo directory. GitHub Actions CI/CD.

eval_notes: Well-maintained Asterisk Docker image with 269 stars. Multiple variants for different use cases. TLS, health checks, and persistent storage support make it suitable for PBX evaluation scenarios.
